limits: Technical qualification of exact declared discrete scientific contracts and named applications, not human scientific endorsement or public release.

Actual fieldline tangency remains a caller precondition. Four historical fixed-interpolant line-refinement monotonicity failures stay recorded; no universal monotone refinement claim.

Noncore plotting/formatting and original nonfunctioning or commented APIs are excluded with inherited evidence; functioning geometry, data reading, state evolution and convergence control remain covered.

np.matrix deprecations and netCDF4 ABI warning retained from accepted D2; successful bounded numerical cases do not establish blanket ABI compatibility.
